NOTICE OF DECISION
This direct appeal of the Taxpayer’s Petition for Review of the 2024-2025
Unsecured Tax Roll came before the State Board of Equalization (“State Board”) for
hearing on September 29, 2025.
The Respondent presented the State Board with a signed Stipulation from the
Taxpayer for review and approval by the State Board. The Stipulation was signed by
Taxpayer on September 2, 2025.
The parties agree to the following:
The taxable value shall remain as follows:
Roll: 2024 – 2025 Apportionment Revised Taxable Value
Adjustment
Personal Property 8.0% $8,531,254
///
///
///

DECISION
The State Board, having considered the signed Stipulation, voted unanimously to
approve the Stipulation presented. The taxable value for the property subject to the direct
appeal for the 2024-2025 Roll shall be as set forth in the Stipulation.
